incidents.name: SellToken03 unchecked user input
incidents.notes: The SellToken03 contract trusts a caller-supplied token/amount pair when settling a sale and never validates it against what was actually received, so the attacker had it pay out against a worthless input.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x84Be9475051a08ee5364fBA44De7FE83a5eCC4f1 created 2023-03-23T12:46:48Z by 0x20d815e42ecdeff5cc14b142df817825b15b88dd, unrelated to attack sender 0x0060129430df7ea188be3d8818404a2d40896089; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The exploit transaction is funded by a 446.64 WBNB DODO flash loan that is repaid in full, so the profit is not visible as a net WBNB flow; lossUsd uses the ~$109k reported by DeFiHackLabs and Eocene.
